newsitem.title: USA: HealthPlan to acquire Health Risk.
newsitem.headline: HealthPlan to acquire Health Risk.

text.p: HealthPlan Services Corp said on Friday it had agreed to buy Health Risk Management Inc for about $80 million in cash and stock.
HealthPlan said each share of Health Risk will be swapped for $9.69 cash and, on a tax-free basis, 0.360208 share of HealthPlan.
The deal values each Health Risk share at about $17.75.
Shares of HealthPlan closed up 2/8 at at 22-3/8 on Thursday and shares of Health Risk closed at 15-1/2.
HealthPlan said it would take a charge of about $18 million during the balance of this year. The charges will cover expenses related to two previous acquisitions.
HealthPlan also said it would take a one-time, non-cash charge of $20 million related to the write-off of intangibles in connection with past acquisitions.
The deal with Health Risk is expected to be non-dilutive in 1997, HealthPlan said, and should be completed in early 1997.
Health Risk, a managed care services company, is based in Minneapolis, Minn. In fiscal 1996 it reported $54 million in revenues.
